facts.fact: David 的病态思想实验：死后意识困在身体里、永久瘫痪、被埋进土里
facts.anchor: What if, long after death, his mind kept on living inside his body?

facts.fact: 自我审判：youth wasted on young→life wasted on living；他这一生=staring at screens/sending girls to hell
facts.anchor: Staring at screens. Sending girls to hell.

facts.fact: 凌晨 2:49、众人从 Austin 回来后：Douglas 绑在营房、Bethany 锁在 pantry；David 独自走进沙漠约半英里
facts.anchor: He walks about half a mile through the sand

facts.fact: 他闭眼想象自己被埋/太空人/尸体在地下，trick 大脑信以为真一秒，感受恐慌后 call back
facts.anchor: It’s a momentary catch of panic that overrides everything else.

facts.fact: 回到监控中心：32 块屏，其中一块直连地下 Conductor、最亮、最可能见到 Erin 的静电显影
facts.anchor: There are thirty-two screens in here total.

facts.fact: 谜语 What never stops moving but always remains static? 答案 static itself
facts.anchor: What never stops moving but always remains static?

facts.fact: 笔记本上 Bethany 锁在无窗小屋的画面；David 通灵催她 Please hurry up
facts.anchor: Please hurry up. They’ll be here soon

facts.fact: 静电 ping-pong 在其余 31 块屏上，用他多年不懂的语言低语
facts.anchor: Static ping-pongs all around him, bouncing off the thirty-one other screens
